query: SELECT event_type,action,actor_login,created_at,updated_at,title,body,comment_id,comments,state,closed_at,file_time,repo_name,number FROM github_events WHERE repo_name='silverstripe/silverstripe-framework' AND number=8080 AND event_type IN ('IssuesEvent','IssueCommentEvent') ORDER BY created_at,file_time FORMAT JSON

data.title: Remove email in "password sent" URL (reduce personal data)
data.body:
We're mentioning the email address on the success screen after using the "lost password" form. That means email addresses (personal data) is stored in web server logs, referers etc - that's making it harder to comply to regulations like GDPR. We should remove this email data from the URL, either into PHP sessions or (preferrably) by just not requiring this info on the screen.

See https://github.com/silverstripe/silverstripe-framework/issues/7791 for context

data.title: Remove email in "password sent" URL (reduce personal data)
data.body: I think we should remove the email address altogether. It currently doesn't help that much, and most sites don't use it (instead just having a standard message like "We have sent you a password reset email, if an account existed with that address" in all situations).
